# Third-party notices

The bundled WASM is built from the official Inochi2D D SDK at commit
`f4b4917a59419e64f2704ac7b806e2bf09bca752` (BSD-2-Clause).

It also includes `numem`, `nurt`, `nulib`, `numath`, and `intel-intrinsics`
(BSL-1.0), `gamut` (BSL-1.0 and MIT components), and `miniz` (MIT). Exact
versions and hashes are recorded in the source repository under
`tools/official-sdk`.

The complete upstream license and notice texts for the exact bundled versions
are included in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.
